note: Real export shipments are confirmed by dated customs/B-L rows, not by website claims: repeated sea consignments of TMT/deformed bars and GI binding wire from Chennai Sea (INMAA1) and Tuticorin Sea (INTUT1) to buyers in Male, Maldives (Alia Construction Pvt Ltd, Dhandhoo Holdings, Nooradheen Investment), latest 2026-02-28.
